_about: Naming conventions for Claude chats. Read by claude-chat-picker and the chat-name-nudge mod. 'folders' keys are path prefixes; the longest match wins and its text is added to 'default'.
default: 3-7 words, lowercase except proper nouns, no trailing period, no quotes. Say WHAT the chat is about (the deliverable or problem), not how it went. Prefer concrete nouns: tool, product, client or file names. No generic words like 'chat', 'session', 'help with', 'discussion'.

folders./Users/you/scratch: A general scratch folder with many unrelated projects. Lead with the project or tool the chat is about, then the specific task.
folders./Users/you/code/my-app: Work on my-app. Lead with the area ('api', 'ui', 'billing'), then the specific task.
